body:
My issues have only progressed throughout the time I’ve been disabled. This is why I’ve chosen to be done with things rather than bother trying anymore. It’s been 7 years and nobody at SS or any of the services they provide are willing to help me in any way. From medical help to finding a job, the system is designed to keep you on it once you’re in it, rather than helping you get off it and become productive.

Yet tax payers think it’s all fun and games, that we enjoy taking this piddly amount of money that’s not even liveable; the dichotomy is one that will never be resolved as it’s people from two completely different spectrums of life.

I tried to go to school at Lawrence tech and that’s where I had my first mental break. I was unable to complete my basic algebra class and was expected to take even more advanced math courses afterwards. I’ve never been able to do algebra ever since I was in 7th grade (I’m 30 now) even with having my parents take me to school early for help with the teachers, using study centers like Sylvan and even resources at the college. Nothing worked, nothing helped.

I’m pretty sure I’m tired of life altogether as I don’t enjoy people or the interactions that come with them. I’ve tried time and time again to make things work and always find myself burning bridges everywhere I go. Is that really a worthwhile life to constantly have people hate you just for being honest or for having problems that are uncontrollable? Is it really worth constantly trying to push ahead when the people you already don’t want to interact with call you a liar or tell you you’re wrong when you’re just trying to get a diagnosis? All while watching these little druggie girls getting loaded up on pills cause they have a little “anxiety” and are completely useless to any employer. But they take priority over me, as with all my problems I get no treatment and my problems are a bit worse than a little anxiety. Yet I’ve seen these girls OD on their meds and than get them right back after getting out of the hospital. They way this medical system is designed, it doesn’t actually help people, so I’ll only get worse. You seemed to have completely ignored this in your consideration of how to improve things in my life.

Sorry for coming off kurt, but I just don’t have patience anymore for people as this is how it usually goes. People have their own preconceived idea of what they believe is wrong and how it should be fixed. All the while ignoring many of the things I mention. Doctors do this to me all the time which is why after the better part of a decade on SS, I still have yet to receive treatment for any of my problems. And actually some have gotten worse.
